```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(jsonlite)

# Create new manifest.json
pkgs <- sessionInfo()$otherPkgs
pkg_list <- list()

for (pkg in names(pkgs)) {
  pkg_list[[pkg]] <- list(
    Source = "CRAN",
    Repository = "https://cran.rstudio.com"
  )
}

manifest <- list(
  version = 1,
  locale = "en_US",
  platform = R.version$version.string,
  metadata = list(
    appmode = "shiny", # Options: "shiny", "api" (Plumber), "rmd", or "static"
    entrypoint = "app.R"
  ),
  packages = pkg_list,
  files = as.list(list.files(".", recursive = FALSE))
)

write_json(manifest, "manifest.json", auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
```
